notes:
- New: AI strategy writer (Studies > Strategies) - describe your idea in plain English, click Generate; Refine changes it. Nothing is saved until you click Add Strategy
- Every AI strategy passes a safety check, a lookahead check (no peeking at future candles) and a trial backtest; one free automatic fix if a check fails
- Uses your own free AI key: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter or Ollama on your PC, with an optional backup provider. Your key stays on your PC
- AI requests per day: Basic 5, Gold 20, Platinum unlimited
- Simpler tabs: Live Signals and Performance removed - Paper Trading (now tab 6) and Alerts cover them
